card.name: The phrase "by way of"
card.fires_on: The word "way" or "of" in the phrase "by way of", such as "by way of analogy" or "by way of contrast". It fires on the word just before "of" or on "of" itself.

modes.label: of after by way
modes.description: The word "of" completing "by way of" before a noun such as analogy, reprisals or a named law.
modes.example: is posted on the Urban Gateway by way<< of>> keeping all users informed

modes.label: way after by
modes.example: counting on internal support by<< way>> of uprisings and desertions and

card.plain: It marks the stock phrase "by way of", meaning through or as a form of.
